cases.name: Exact degree and field
cases.rationale: Master's degree in Computer Science: its degree level meets or exceeds the required level; its field of study matches exactly.

cases.name: Above the required level
cases.rationale: Doctorate in Computer Science: its degree level meets or exceeds the required level; its field of study matches exactly.

cases.name: One level below
cases.rationale: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science: its degree is one level below the required level; its field of study matches exactly.

cases.name: Two levels below
cases.rationale: Associate degree in Computer Science: its degree is two levels below the required level; its field of study matches exactly.

cases.name: Distant field
cases.rationale: Master's degree in Business Administration: its field of study is distant from the required one; its degree level meets or exceeds the required level.

cases.name: Close field
cases.rationale: Master's degree in Software Engineering: its field of study is close to the required one; its degree level meets or exceeds the required level.

cases.name: Unknown field
cases.rationale: Master's degree: its field of study is not stated; its degree level meets or exceeds the required level.

cases.name: No diploma
cases.rationale: The candidate sheet lists no obtained diploma.

cases.name: Ongoing diploma
cases.rationale: No obtained diploma: the candidate's diploma is still in progress (no end date).

cases.name: Professional certificate vs degree
cases.rationale: Professional certificate in Computer Science: a Professional certificate is a credential, not a degree level; its field of study matches exactly.
